market_question: Will ByteDance have the highest IPO Market Cap 2026?
reasoning: ByteDance is one of the world's most valuable private companies (~$200B+), so if it IPOs in 2026, it would very likely be the largest. However, US-China tensions and regulatory hurdles make an IPO in 2026 uncertain. I estimate the true probability of ByteDance completing an IPO and having the highest market cap at about 4%, which is vastly above the market’s implied 0.2%.
evidence_points: ByteDance’s private valuations (>$200B) make it one of the largest IPO candidates globally.
TikTok forced-sale pressure and Chinese tech sector restrictions reduce the likelihood of a 2026 IPO.
Even if ByteDance lists, potential large IPOs from SpaceX or others could challenge the top rank, but overall chance is still well above 0.2%.
